leaves.name: sga1_XII_3_3a
leaves.doc: sga1-fix: SGA 1 XII Remarque 3.3(a) (f etale implies f^an a local isomorphism), topological part, special case f : U -> A^n with U an affine open of X locally of finite type over C: Q -> (f_i(Q)) is a homeomorphism from an open neighbourhood of each P in U(C) (analytic topology) onto an open subset of C^n (printed form, special case and consequence; the regular-functions half is proved in Lean; locator UNVERIFIED)

leaves.source: SGA 1 (Grothendieck, LNM 224, 1971), Exp. XII, Remarque 3.3(a), p. 325 (page per the 11-16 review), with the analytic space of XII 1.1 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: properCompactAn
leaves.doc: unif-topology: X proper over C implies X(C) compact in the analytic topology (printed form; SGA 1 XII 3.2 for proper C-schemes locally of finite type, the leaf's generality; Serre, GAGA 2 Prop. 6 for varieties; locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.source: SGA 1 (Grothendieck, LNM 224, 1971), Exp. XII, Prop. 3.2 (f proper iff f^an proper; with Y = Spec C: X proper iff X^an compact); Serre, GAGA (1956), 2, Prop. 6 (for varieties) (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: sga1_XII_2_4
leaves.doc: sga1-fix: SGA 1 XII 2.4, only-if direction: X locally of finite type over C and connected implies X^an connected, with connected = Mathlib PreconnectedSpace on both sides (X(C) with the analytic topology) (printed form; locator UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: serreGAGAMorphism
leaves.doc: gaga-serre: Serre's GAGA for holomorphic maps of projective varieties: for X, Y reduced closed subschemes of P^N_C (IsProjVar), every holomorphic map X^h -> Y^h in Serre's sense (IsSerreHolMap: continuous for the analytic topology glued from affine pieces, pulls back germs of SerreHolAt, the local restrictions of holomorphic functions of affine coordinates) is P -> P >> f for a morphism of C-schemes f : X -> Y (printed form; Serre's X^h is reduced by construction, and AnFunAt/IsAnMorphism are proved equal to Serre's objects; locator UNVERIFIED)
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf, no reading recorded; locator UNVERIFIED; the check should confirm that GAGA section 4 prints the holomorphic-map statement itself (not only Chow's theorem, Prop. 13) and with no irreducibility hypothesis
leaves.source: J.-P. Serre, Geometrie algebrique et geometrie analytique, Ann. Inst. Fourier 6 (1956), 1-42, section 4, the proposition on holomorphic maps of projective varieties (proved from Prop. 13, Chow, through the graph) (section, number and wording UNVERIFIED)
